# Transport (`transport`)

Play, step, loop and timecode.

Group: Media & editors. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/media';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createTransport` (types in `dist/web/media/transport.d.ts`): `.mh-transport` (`--sm | --lg`): go to start, step back, play / pause (filled accent, its name switches betweenPlay and Pause), step forward, go to end, an optional loop toggle (`aria-pressed`) and the timecode(`__time` with `__current` and `__duration`). Parts: `__button` (`__skip`, `__loop`), `__play`. Steps are one frame with `fps`.

```ts
export function createTransport(options: TransportOptions): TransportHandle;

export interface TransportOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the group ("Playback"). */
  label: string;
  playing?: boolean;
  /** Seconds. */
  position?: number;
  /** Seconds; 0 or missing hides the duration. */
  duration?: number;
  /** Frames per second: the timecode gains frames and a step is one frame. */
  fps?: number;
  /** Seconds per step without `fps` (default 1). */
  step?: number;
  /** Shows the loop toggle with this state; leave it out to hide the toggle. */
  loop?: boolean;
  /** Shows go-to-start and go-to-end (default true). */
  skip?: boolean;
  /** Shows the step buttons (default true). */
  steps?: boolean;
  size?: TransportSize;
  disabled?: boolean;
  labels?: Partial<TransportLabels>;
  onPlayingChange?: (playing: boolean) => void;
  /** A new position from the step and skip buttons. */
  onSeek?: (position: number) => void;
  onLoopChange?: (loop: boolean) => void;
}

export interface TransportHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  setPlaying(playing: boolean): void;
  setPosition(position: number): void;
  setDuration(duration: number): void;
  setLoop(loop: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}

export interface TransportLabels {
  start: string;
  stepBack: string;
  play: string;
  pause: string;
  stepForward: string;
  end: string;
  loop: string;
  position: string;
  duration: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createTransport } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const duration = 222;
let position = 41;
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined;

const transport = createTransport({
  label: 'Playback',
  duration,
  position,
  loop: false,
  onPlayingChange: (playing) => {
    clearInterval(timer);
    if (!playing) return;
    timer = setInterval(() => {
      position = position >= duration ? 0 : position + 1;
      transport.setPosition(position);
    }, 1000);
  },
  onSeek: (t) => (position = t),
});

document.body.append(transport.el);
```

## React API

`Transport` (types in `dist/react/media-editors.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createTransport`. The props are the state; presses update it until new props arrive.

```ts
export function Transport(props: TransportProps);

export interface TransportProps {
  label: string;
  playing?: boolean;
  position?: number;
  duration?: number;
  fps?: number;
  step?: number;
  /** Shows the loop toggle with this state. */
  loop?: boolean;
  skip?: boolean;
  steps?: boolean;
  size?: TransportSize;
  disabled?: boolean;
  labels?: Partial<TransportLabels>;
  onPlayingChange?: (playing: boolean) => void;
  onSeek?: (position: number) => void;
  onLoopChange?: (loop: boolean) => void;
  className?: string;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Transport } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const DURATION = 222;

export function TransportExample() {
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [position, setPosition] = useState(41);
  const [loop, setLoop] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!playing) return;
    const timer = setInterval(() => setPosition((p) => (p >= DURATION ? 0 : p + 1)), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [playing]);
  return (
    <Transport
      label="Playback"
      duration={DURATION}
      position={position}
      playing={playing}
      loop={loop}
      onPlayingChange={setPlaying}
      onSeek={setPosition}
      onLoopChange={setLoop}
    />
  );
}
```
